what: Public court cases against developers we track, each with its case number. Facts only: court, number, date, the companies named, what the record says and the outcome or status. Private individuals who sued are not named. A filed complaint states allegations, not findings.
method: Searched the published judgments of the DIFC Courts (difccourts.ae) and press reports that print a case number, for developers and projects in our records, on 19 Nov 2026.
Official court pages are marked official; where only a press report or a docket index prints the number, the source is named.
Dubai Courts, most national courts and arbitration awards do not publish searchable judgments: a developer missing here may still have cases.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: Claim over a 2009 reservation agreement for an off-plan commercial unit in the Park Towers development, DIFC (AED 4,544,000).
cases.result: The defendant was ordered to pay AED 2,626,335 in restitution, with interest at 3-month EIBOR + 1% and the claimant's costs.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: Claim for a specified sum of money; the page does not describe the underlying dispute.
cases.result: Default judgment (no acknowledgment of service or defence filed): USD 11,461,813 within 14 days, with interest, a USD 20,000 filing fee and USD 90,000 in costs.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: A buyer sought to rescind a 2010 sale and purchase agreement for a residential unit in Park Towers, DIFC, alleging misrepresentation about completion, size, view and parking.
cases.result: The buyer's claim was dismissed; the developer's counterclaim for specific performance (taking possession of the unit) was granted and the buyer was ordered to pay AED 370,000 in damages and interest.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: Claim against the developer; the order names no project. The developer had applied to contest the jurisdiction of the DIFC Courts.
cases.result: Claim discontinued; the claimant was ordered to pay the developer's costs of AED 118,735.50.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.party: Deyaar Development P.J.S.C. (second defendant, with National Bonds Corporation P.J.S.C.)
cases.what: Dispute over the sale of a 33% interest in the Sky Gardens residential building, DIFC, and an AED 72,141,913 payment made in December 2008.
cases.result: The court found that a binding agreement to transfer the interest was concluded on 4 December 2008; Deyaar's case that no binding contract existed, and its case for setting the deal aside, failed.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: The claimant asked the court to stop Deyaar pursuing a claim against him in the Dubai Courts, arising from the Sky Gardens transaction above.
cases.result: Claim dismissed; no order as to costs.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.what: Claim for a specified sum of money; the order does not describe the dispute.
cases.result: Default judgment: USD 76,305.78 plus 9% statutory interest and USD 20,067.80 in costs, payable within 14 days.

cases.court: DIFC Courts, Court of First Instance
cases.party: Union Properties P.J.S.C. and UPP Capital Investment LLC
cases.what: Claim (filed 10 June 2025) for declarations on the meaning of an agreement; the court granted declarations substantially as sought on 9 December 2025.
cases.result: Permission to appeal the 9 December 2025 declarations was refused, with costs against the defendants.

cases.court: Commercial Court, Central Jakarta District Court
cases.what: A creditor applied for a suspension of debt payments (PKPU), saying a 2024 court-approved settlement over land sold in Senopati for an apartment development was not paid in full. The ruling as reported does not name the project.
cases.result: Application rejected: the court found it lacked legal grounds and that the company could meet its obligations.
